newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA CDMA PHONE TO BE AVAILABLE IN AUG.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA CDMA PHONE TO BE AVAILABLE IN AUG.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement its first CDMA phone had been introduced in the United States on Monday and would be available this month.
"Nokia ... today introduced the Nokia 2180," the company said in a statement. "The CDMA phone will be available this month through carriers, dealers and selected retailers," it said.
The new CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access) mobile phone is based on the design of Nokia's award-winning Nokia 2100 series, which Nokia said was "the single largest digital platform in the world."
Releasing on August 4 its first-half earnings report, Nokia said the new CDMA phone was already being shipped to U.S. markets. @

"The Nokia 2180 ... marks a significant milestone for the industry by incorporating Nokia's own CDMA chip design into the phone, for the first time providing customers with a choice in selecting CDMA digital technology," it said.
